job_title: Lead Full Stack Engineer, Exception Management and Workflow Platform
job_description:
As a Lead Full Stack Engineer, you will design and build the exception management, workflow orchestration, and governance platform that keeps case resolution running smoothly across Citi's enterprise systems. You will architect scalable microservices and intuitive user interfaces, and translate complex business requirements into secure, high-performing software. This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, giving you ownership over how exceptions, approvals, and entitlements are managed at enterprise scale.
Responsibilities
• Architect and build scalable microservices and REST APIs in Java and Spring Boot that power enterprise-wide exception and case management.
• Design exception and case management workflows, covering intake, validation, case creation, allocation, and resolution tracking.
• Develop workflow orchestration using tools such as Camunda or Flowable to enable dynamic routing, task assignment, escalations, and SLA management.
• Build configurable maker-checker approval frameworks that enforce multi-level approvals, segregation of duties, and delegation policies.
• Implement entitlement and governance controls, including role- and attribute-based access, fine-grained UI permissions, and full audit trails.
• Design event-driven integrations with Kafka to support asynchronous processing, real-time notifications, and ServiceNow connectivity.
• Build high-volume React and TypeScript interfaces, including dashboards and task inboxes, that give users clear visibility into their work.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• 6+ years of experience in applications development, and managing complex technical projects within financial services or a similarly regulated industry.
• Hands-on proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, with a track record of architecting secure, scalable microservices, REST APIs and shared platform services consumed across multiple enterprise applications.
• Experience with workflow orchestration engines such as Camunda, Flowable, or other BPMN-based tools, including dynamic routing, task assignment, escalations and SLA management.
• Experience designing maker-checker approval frameworks, segregation of duties, entitlement models such as RBAC or ABAC, and audit trail capabilities.
• Event-Driven Architecture: Strong Kafka experience for asynchronous processing, event-based workflows, notifications and ServiceNow integration.
• Proficiency in React and TypeScript for building complex, high-volume enterprise user interfaces.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Platform Architecture & Scalability: Proven ability to design secure, resilient, high-performance shared services consumed by multiple enterprise applications.
Beneficial Skills & Qualifications
• Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
What We Offer
Joining Citi's Applications Development team means working on technology that is central to how the bank manages risk, governance, and operational resilience, while building your career within a global organization.
• Work in a hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.
• Lead and grow a team of engineers while deepening your own expertise in modern, event-driven architecture.
• Access ongoing learning and development programs to build new technical and leadership capabilities.
• Benefit from competitive compensation and resources that support your financial wellbeing.
• Collaborate with colleagues and technology teams across Citi's global network on platforms used enterprise-wide.
Apply today to lead the team building Citi's next-generation exception management and workflow governance platform.

26983950 Lead Web3 Engineer - Digital Assets Platform Discover your future at Citi
Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.
Job Overview
An Digital Assets Platform Web3 Engineer must be a highly motivated and proactive hands-on software engineer (Back End, Java Focus), have a proven ability and experience working with web applications in production. The successful candidate will be part of the core team continuing to build our Citi Integrated Digital Assets Platform (CIDAP). The ideal candidate will be a self-driven, proactive, strong enterprise developer and resourceful team player who can comfortably work with a large team of highly motivated individuals within Citi’s larger softwzare engineering network.
We are looking for candidates who understand how to build the backend of enterprise-grade web applications. The successful individual should understand the basics of web3 infrastructure, blockchain technology and digital assets, and must be a strong enterprise developer of web applications. Experience and knowledge of web3 application development is a plus.
Key Responsibilities
• Develop, test, and maintain backend software components and services that integrate with blockchain networks and digital asset infrastructure
• Implement blockchain integrations — including node connectivity, transaction submission, on-chain event monitoring, and wallet interactions — using enterprise Java and Web3 libraries
• Write, test, and deploy smart contracts in Solidity or equivalent languages, following established security and quality standards
• Build and maintain APIs and microservices that expose blockchain functionality to upstream platform consumers and business applications
• Implement asynchronous and event-driven processing to manage transaction lifecycle, on-chain state changes, and blockchain data synchronization
• Participate actively in code reviews, contributing constructive feedback and maintaining high standards of code quality, readability, and test coverage
• Collaborate with architects, senior engineers, and product teams to understand requirements and translate them into well-structured, maintainable software solutions

• Follow and contribute to engineering best practices, coding standards, and Agile delivery processes within the team
• Stay informed of developments in the blockchain and Web3 ecosystem, including protocol updates, new tooling, and emerging standards relevant to the platform
• Participate in sprint ceremonies — planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives — as part of an Agile/Scrum delivery team
Qualifications/ Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in CS or Engineering; MS or PhD in computer science, or related discipline a plus
• Extensive experience in full software development and testing lifecycle. Experience from financial services industry is a plus.
• Proven experience and expertise with Backend web development with Java spring
• Solid experience in web3 application development is a plus
• Solid experience and expertise developing web applications using asynchronous programming and communication
• Experience and expertise developing web applications adhering to best practices and patterns for reliability, scalability, and performance

• Familiarity of Agile Methodology and Scrum is a plus

job_description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Austin, London, or San Francisco (Hybrid)
About the team
Search engines spent two decades learning what the web is worth: which pages are fresh, which sources are trusted, what people actually use. That knowledge came from watching how humans moved through the web.
Agents break that loop. AI models are trained and grounded on the web, but they have little visibility into what's changed, what's authoritative, or what's been fabricated. Site owners have it worse: AI crawlers already request content anywhere from a hundred to tens of thousands of times for every visitor they send back, and most have no idea how, or whether, they show up in AI answers. Both sides of the market are flying blind.
Cloudflare sits in front of around 20% of the web and sees both sides of that exchange. Our team, the Agentic Internet team, is focused on making the web readable, discoverable, callable, and payable, built on open standards so no single company owns the rails. Signals & Data Products turns our network's view into products both sides can use: helping AI labs know what's fresh and trustworthy, and helping site owners see and shape how they show up in AI. Cloudflare believes in the open Internet, and we're in a position to help build the future where it thrives. Come help us make it happen! You can read more about some of our plans here and here. What you'll do
Drive the strategy for Signals, our web intelligence feed, and shape where our data products go next
Define what makes a signal worth paying for (freshness, provenance, trust, real-world usage) using data from Cloudflare's network
Build for both sides of the market: data products for AI labs, and visibility for site owners into how AI models find, use, and cite them
Explore what comes next, from knowledge graphs to measuring how sites show up in AI answers
Deliver product specifications, prototypes, product positioning, and high-impact launches
Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Research, and GTM to ship at high velocity
Work with Partnerships and BD on data partnerships with AI labs and other large buyers
Represent the product externally with users, customers, AI labs, developers, and more
What we're looking for
7+ years as a technical PM, with experience shipping data, search, ranking, or ML products
Deep data fluency: you can reason about data quality, coverage, bias, and pipelines
Experience building or selling data products or APIs (licensing, pricing, enterprise contracts) is a strong plus
A builder: you get things done, can move quickly, and prefer 'show' over 'tell'
A strong communicator who is comfortable with ambiguity
Team oriented: you'd rather get it right than be right
How we work
At Cloudflare, performance is about outcomes (what you did) and behaviors (how you did it). We value curiosity, humility, empathy, and doing the principled thing. Learn more about our values on our Careers page.
Why this role
You'll be building a new product category from a vantage point no one else has, on a fast-moving team breaking new ground. You can read about our early research here. Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Equity

Benefits

Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

job_title: UK Background Checks: A Hiring Guide
job_description:
This article explains what UK background checks involve, from common components to legal compliance and practical implementation. Learn how to design proportionate, fair employment screening and apply criminal record checks correctly to protect your business and candidates.
The phrase background checks UK usually refers to the set of vetting steps employers use to confirm a candidate’s identity, integrity, and suitability. Done well, employment screening reduces hiring risk, protects customers, and helps organizations meet regulatory obligations while maintaining fairness and privacy. Employers often integrate comprehensive databases and employ verification software to ensure accuracy and efficiency in their checks.
Common components include identity and right to work validation, criminal record checks via the Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) when eligible, verification of qualifications and employment history, professional license checks, and reference confirmation. For regulated or high-risk roles, employers may add credit checks, sanctions and adverse media screening, or driving record reviews as proportionate to the role. Integrating social media analysis can offer additional perspectives on candidates' public personas, aligning personality fits with company cultures.
Compliance is essential. Employers should obtain explicit consent, apply a clear lawful basis under the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, follow the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (including filtering rules), and avoid discrimination under the Equality Act 2010. Only conduct checks that are necessary for the role, limit data retention, and ensure candidates can access and correct their information. Implementing compliance monitoring systems can further safeguard against inadvertent violations.
To implement an effective programme, define a written policy, standardize role-based packages, and choose vetted providers with secure data handling and transparent pricing. Time checks after a conditional offer, explain outcomes to candidates, and use a fair, documented review process for any adverse findings, aligning decisions to job relevance and risk. Regularly audit employment screening workflows, train hiring teams, and update policies as laws or industry guidance evolve, ensuring continuous improvement in your vetting processes.
In today's digital age, technology plays a crucial role in streamlining the background check process. Online platforms and automated systems can expedite identity verification and criminal record checks, reducing time-to-hire while maintaining accuracy and compliance. Businesses that leverage these tools effectively can gain a competitive edge in attracting top talent. Implementing AI-powered solutions allows for predictive analysis of candidate compatibility, enhancing decisions beyond traditional metrics.
Enhancing the candidate experience is critical in today’s competitive job market. Transparent communication about the background check process can alleviate candidate concerns. Employers should clearly articulate the steps involved in screenings, the rationale behind the checks, and how the information will be used. Providing candidates with a timeline and maintaining open lines of communication throughout the hiring process can foster trust and demonstrate respect for applicant privacy. Hosting informational webinars can further demystify the process.
A failure to conduct thorough and compliant background checks can expose organizations to legal liabilities. In the UK, ignoring compliance with existing laws such as the Data Protection Act 2018 or the Employment Rights Act 1996 may result in sanctions or penalties. Employers need to be aware of the repercussions of negligent hiring, including potential litigation from affected parties due to workplace mishaps related to incomplete candidate vetting. A robust risk assessment framework can mitigate these dangers.
Employers should be mindful of the need to maintain diversity and prevent unconscious bias in the background check process. Screening processes must be designed to evaluate candidates fairly without discrimination. Careful interpretation of background check results, with attention to cultural and socioeconomic differences, helps in making equitable hiring decisions. Companies should regularly review their policies to ensure alignment with diversity goals and legal standards. Incorporating bias-awareness training can bolster these efforts.
Beyond traditional checks, psychometric testing provides insight into a candidate’s personality traits and cognitive capabilities, offering a fuller picture of how they might fit within a role. Integrating psychometric assessments into the screening process can support better hiring decisions by identifying candidates whose values align with the company's culture and mission. This approach is especially useful in roles requiring specific interpersonal skills or leadership qualities. Supplementing with emotional intelligence assessments can refine this approach further.
Brexit has brought about changes to employment laws affecting background checks. New immigration policies and the end of free movement between the UK and EU have introduced additional requirements for verifying work eligibility. Companies must adapt by understanding the implications of these changes on their hiring practices and ensure that they remain compliant with the latest immigration and employment verification rules. Engaging with legal experts can provide clarity on navigating this complex landscape.
Incorporate a strong background check process as part of your company’s reputation management strategy. Employers perceived as thorough and fair in their hiring practices attract higher quality candidates and retain a positive image in the industry. Background checks contribute to this by mitigating risks and confirming that employees uphold company values. This, in turn, enhances employer branding and competitiveness in hiring. Regular industry benchmarking can ensure practices meet evolving standards.
Keeping pace with evolving technologies, background checks in the future may include the use of blockchain for secure data sharing, ensuring tamper-proof and transparent processes. Augmented reality (AR) could also play a role in predictive hiring simulations, allowing companies to visualize candidate interactions within digital environments. These innovations promise to enhance the efficiency and reliability of background screening while safeguarding data integrity. Investing in these technologies reflects a forward-thinking employer branding strategy.
Globalization has also impacted the way background checks are conducted in the UK. With more businesses operating across borders, international background checks have become increasingly vital. These checks can uncover information about a candidate’s international criminal history, qualifications, and employment records, ensuring a more comprehensive evaluation of the applicant. Companies willing to invest in international checks can better manage risk and protect their interests in a global marketplace. Establishing partnerships with global vetting agencies can streamline these checks.

Why we need this role
The Manager, Infrastructure Engineering, Linux Platforms leads the team responsible for designing, deploying, automating and maintaining the secure Linux-based infrastructure that supports critical telecommunications network services. The platform scope includes DNS, routing control infrastructure, authentication and identity services, network observability, monitoring and related network-management capabilities.
The role combines people leadership, service ownership and technical governance. It is accountable for team capability, technology roadmaps, platform lifecycle, operational performance, security, resilience, automation and managed-service outcomes. The Manager works closely with Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture and Operations to ensure platforms are secure by design, operationally supportable and aligned with network strategy.
The successful candidate will manage a team of approximately four Linux specialists and managed-service resources located in India and the UK, supporting a distributed estate of hundreds of Linux systems that underpin critical telecommunications operations.
Platforms and Services
The team designs, deploys, automates and maintains Linux infrastructure supporting:
• Authoritative, recursive and caching DNS services.
• Route reflectors and other routing control-plane services.
• Authentication, authorisation and accounting services.
• Identity management, directory and privileged-access integrations.
• Network observability, telemetry, logging and monitoring platforms.
• Network-management and automation services.
• Virtualised and, where appropriate, containerised infrastructure.
• Supporting services such as NTP, PKI, certificate management, secure repositories and configuration services.
What you will do
Leadership and Team Management
• Lead, recruit, mentor and develop Linux engineers and managed-service resources, building sustainable capability and succession.
• Set clear accountabilities, priorities and objectives and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence and continuous improvement.
• Maintain sufficient technical depth to lead engineering decisions, challenge designs and support major incidents, while developing Senior Engineers as the primary technical authorities for assigned platforms and services.
• Allocate resources across operational, project and lifecycle demand and ensure effective knowledge sharing across UK and India locations.
Service Ownership, Strategy and Governance
• Own the strategy, roadmap and service lifecycle for Linux-based network infrastructure and associated services.
• Set platform standards, reference architectures, operating procedures and governance for technical exceptions.
• Own service performance, availability, capacity, continuity, recoverability and operational readiness outcomes.
• Manage platform currency, technical debt, upgrades, obsolescence and decommissioning plans.
• Prioritise investment and demand across Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture and Operations.
• Govern managed-service and supplier performance, including service quality, delivery commitments and improvement actions.
Engineering, Resilience and Operational Excellence
• Drive standardisation and automation using Ansible, scripting and infrastructure-as-code principles to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
• Ensure monitoring, logging, security controls, backup and support documentation are included as part of every platform build.
• Define measurable objectives for availability, capacity, recoverability, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle risk and automation coverage.
• Ensure critical services have tested backup, restoration, failover, continuity and disaster-recovery arrangements.
• Lead major-incident response, risk escalation and stakeholder communications when required.
• Ensure effective problem, change, capacity, availability and continuity management across the service portfolio.
Security, Compliance and Risk
• Own the platform security roadmap, control outcomes, risk posture and governance of security exceptions.
• Ensure secure-by-design practices, threat modelling and appropriate segregation of administrative access are applied.
• Oversee vulnerability remediation, privileged access, secrets, keys, certificates, centralised audit logging and software repository security.
• Ensure the team can support security incidents while preserving relevant operational and forensic evidence.
• Ensure compliance evidence is complete, repeatable and available for audit and regulatory review.
Collaboration and Documentation
• Partner with Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture, Operations and application teams to align platform priorities and dependencies.
• Ensure technical designs, service documentation, support models, runbooks and audit evidence are maintained throughout the lifecycle.
• Communicate technical risk, performance, investment needs and roadmap progress clearly to technical and senior leadership audiences.
Operational Support
• Participate in the Infrastructure Operations on-call rota and provide leadership for priority incidents.
What we are looking for
Required Skills and Experience
• Extensive experience leading or engineering enterprise Linux platforms such as RHEL and Ubuntu; CentOS or compatible distributions are beneficial.
• Proven people leadership, coaching, resource planning and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.
• Strong understanding of service ownership, platform lifecycle, operational governance and managed-service delivery.
• Strong Linux automation skills using Ansible, Bash or Python and infrastructure-as-code principles.
• Strong understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, DNS, routing principles and BGP.
• Knowledge of network segmentation, firewalls, load balancing, NTP, PKI, TLS, certificate lifecycle, authentication and identity services.
• Experience managing high availability, backup, restoration, continuity and disaster recovery.
• Strong knowledge of ISO 27001 and CIS benchmarks, including vulnerability, privileged-access and audit controls.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
Desirable Skills and Knowledge
• Experience in adjacent technologies is beneficial but not required across all areas.
• Network observability and monitoring, including metrics, logs, telemetry, alerting and capacity management.
• Virtualisation platforms such as VMware and KVM.
• Container technologies such as Docker or Podman and awareness of Kubernetes.
• Enterprise storage technologies such as SAN and NAS.
• Oracle databases and Linux integration.
• Windows Server environments.
• On-premises and cloud environments, including Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform.
Leadership and Behaviours
• Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for service outcomes, team effectiveness and technical excellence.
• Leadership: influences and collaborates effectively across teams.
• Outcome-driven: focuses on measurable results aligned with business and network objectives.
• Strategic thinking: aligns technical decisions with network and business strategy.
• Problem-solving: develops solutions for current needs while supporting future scale and evolution.
• Communication: communicates clearly with technical, non-technical and senior leadership audiences.
• Collaboration: builds strong relationships across architecture, security, infrastructure, network engineering and operations.
• Adaptability: responds effectively to change and identifies continuous improvement opportunities.
Preferred Qualifications / Education and Experience
• Degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
• Seven or more years of Linux or infrastructure engineering experience, including leadership responsibility.
• RHCE, LFCS, LFCE or relevant network/security certifications are beneficial.
Summary
• Management role accountable for people, services, platform strategy, lifecycle, security, resilience and operational performance of Linux-based infrastructure supporting critical telecommunications network services.

Wootton, Bedfordshire | Full Time | Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm

• Monitor key HR processes including pre-employment checks, onboarding and leavers, ensuring everything happens when it should.

• Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, colleague experience and the effective use of Workday.

• Experience supporting colleagues and managers with HR processes and system-related queries.

THE OPPORTUNITY
As Privacy Counsel, you will be a hands-on member of Cyera's Legal team in London, playing a central part in the day-to-day operation of our global privacy program. You will work across product, business and security teams, covering GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and the growing patchwork of state and international privacy laws.
This is an individual contributor role for a privacy lawyer with 4-5 years of experience who wants broad exposure and real ownership. You will operate the privacy practice: keeping the data inventory and records of processing current, running assessments, handling subprocessor and data subject request processes, updating internal policies and answering customer and privacy questions and setting Cyera’s privacy standards across vendors. We are a lean, fast-moving team, so your work will have an immediate impact and the room to grow is real. You will report and work closely with Cyera's Senior Legal Director and other Legal team members.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Privacy program operations
Work on privacy projects and take day-to-day responsibility for the maintenance of the data inventory and records of processing (RoPA), data flow documentation and retention schedules.
Prepare, update and send privacy notices to the relevant audiences (customers, website visitors, employees and candidates) and work with the team to update privacy artifacts as needed.
Help develop and update internal privacy policies, procedures and training for business and engineering teams.
Assessments and regulatory change
Conduct and document privacy impact assessments (PIAs), data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) and transfer impact assessments (TIAs), and partner with Product and Engineering on privacy-by-design for new features, including AI-related functionality.
Track privacy obligations across GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and other US state and international privacy laws, and translate changes into control, policy or process updates.
Subprocessors, data subject requests and incidents
Support the subprocessor onboarding, notification and disclosure process, working with Procurement, Security and the business to assess new vendors and keep the public subprocessor list current.
Run data subject request (DSR) handling end to end, from intake and verification to response and records.
Support privacy incident response in coordination with Legal and Security, including assessing notification obligations and documenting decisions.
Customer-facing privacy and GRC
Serve as the GRC point of contact for customer and vendor privacy questionnaires and RFPs, including the external privacy sections of security questionnaires.
Review and advise on data processing agreements (DPAs) and privacy terms with customers, partners and vendors, working with the commercial legal team.
Business partnership
Provide timely and accurate advice to your legal team-members.
Advise Product, Sales, Marketing, HR, IT and Security on privacy questions with practical, risk-based guidance that non-legal colleagues can act on.
Escalate high-risk issues early and contribute to a unified, scalable approach to risk across the Legal function.
Requirements
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Qualified to practice law in England & Wales or another European jurisdiction, with 4-5 years of post-qualification experience advising on privacy and data protection.
Solid working knowledge of GDPR and UK GDPR, and familiarity with CCPA/CPRA and other US state and international privacy laws, applied practically and commercially.
Hands-on experience with privacy program operations: RoPA and data mapping, retention, privacy notices, and conducting PIAs, DPIAs and TIAs.
Familiarity with SaaS, security products and related privacy issues.
Experience with data subject requests, vendor and subprocessor reviews, and DPA review and negotiation.
Ability to translate legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance and process changes for product, engineering and business teams.
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English.
A proactive, solution-oriented team player with sound judgment, comfortable owning work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
In-house experience at a technology, SaaS, data security or cloud company, with familiarity with cloud environments and data security concepts.
Experience supporting customer security and privacy questionnaires, RFPs or trust and GRC functions.
Exposure to AI governance and emerging regulation, including the EU AI Act.
A privacy certification such as CIPP/E, CIPM or CIPT.
Experience with privacy or contract management tooling, such as a privacy management platform or a CLM system.

job_description:
MEET DEEPL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
WHAT SETS US APART
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepl/,Instagram https://www.instagram.com/deepl_official/, and our Blog https://www.deepl.com/en/blog.
MEET THE TEAM BEHIND THIS JOURNEY
DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.
The Identity and Access Management team owns DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, group, account, consent and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.
We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will contribute across the Identity services, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external customers and internal engineering teams.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
- Ship Features, Not Just Code: You will build well-scoped features from first commit to production. You won't just write functions in isolation; you will check that your code solves the actual user problem, works in production, and is covered by solid tests.
- Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams, and learn from them. You will take part in code reviews and design discussions, and follow and help improve our shared standards. You ask for help early, and you speak up with questions or ideas when you think there is a better way.
- Leverage Modern Tooling: You will use AI-assisted tools (like Copilot and Claude) to handle boilerplate and refactoring, allowing you to focus on logic and product value. We value engineers who use the best tools to ship faster.
- Build for Quality: You will write well-tested, production-ready code that your team (and your future self) will thank you for. You understand that "speed" doesn't mean "sloppy"—it means building reliable software that doesn't break at 2am. You will participate in incident response, learn from postmortems, and help the team raise the bar on code quality and operational health.
QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
- Ownership and Reliability: You take responsibility for what you ship. You write tests, monitor your code in production, and follow through when things go wrong. You're proactive about flagging issues and asking for help when you need it, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn.
- Strong Engineering Fundamentals: You have a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and clean coding principles. You can take a complex logic problem and break it down into small, solvable pieces. You are curious about what it takes to build and operate reliable, high throughput services, and keen to learn this hands-on.
- Adaptability: You have a good foundation in backend development and server-side systems. Our stack relies on C#/.NET Core, Cassandra, gRPC, and Kubernetes. We don't expect you to be an expert in all of them today, but we expect you to be willing to jump in and learn whatever tool gets the job done.
- Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .
- AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.
What we offer
- Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
- Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
- Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
- Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
- Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
- Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
- 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
- Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
 
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are seeking an AI Architect with advanced experience in designing agentic systems, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures. In this role you will lead the design and support the implementation of AI solutions that meet business needs, align with enterprise architecture standards, and address security, scalability, and maintainability requirements.
The architect will define solution blueprints, establish technical standards, and provide architectural guidance to delivery teams developing AI-enabled enterprise solutions.
You will be working with clients and other third parties, as well as Deloitte teams from across the Firm. You will have the opportunity to work with a huge variety of interesting, international, and world-leading clients who are navigating an evolving marketplace where Agentic AI is taking artificial intelligence to a new level. This technology has the potential to transform various industries by creating higher-order opportunities such as new services, business models, and improved productivity across the value chain. You will have a degree of technical knowledge, as well as the ability to communicate to business users.
Key Responsibilities
* Design end-to-end solution architectures that embed AI capabilities into enterprise systems.
* Establish architectural standards for LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, prompt and context management, and supporting services.
* Evaluate and recommend AI platforms, frameworks, models, and tools based on technical feasibility, architectural fit, security, and long-term scalability.
* Develop solution-specific blueprints covering application components, subsystems, interfaces, integrations, and data flows.
* Translate approved solution elements into designs that satisfy business, technical, security, performance, and scalability requirements.

* Model application, data, integration, and security architectures to support maintainable and scalable solutions.
* Define interaction requirements among application components, subsystems, APIs, and external services.
* Lead architecture reviews and technical design assessments.
* Ensure that proposed designs align with enterprise architecture standards and security requirements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, security teams, infrastructure teams, and delivery teams to translate requirements into practical technical designs.
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, performance considerations, and integration constraints.
* Document architecture decisions, design patterns, interface requirements, and implementation guidance.

Required Qualifications
* Proven years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, or a related technical architecture role.
* Hands-on experience designing AI and LLM-based solutions.
* Experience with agentic architectures including LLM integration, observability and identity management patterns.
* Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, event-driven integration, and cloud-native design patterns.
* Experience designing secure, scalable, and highly available enterprise solutions.
* Experience defining and applying architecture standards across multiple delivery teams.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews and technical design assessments.
* Understanding of enterprise security, data protection, identity, access management, and secure AI design principles.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience in the insurance industry.
* Experience with cloud platforms and managed AI services.
* Experience with API management, containerization, Kubernetes, and DevOps practices.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities with core insurance enterprise data platforms.

Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™
Location
This is a fully remote opportunity based out of any of the following with travel as needed: UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Sweden, Estonia.
Who We Are
Become part of the team behind Attribute™. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.
DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.
The Opportunity
As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.
Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.
As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.
You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.
You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.
Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscale teams, and show up at industry events that matter.

Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience
Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job
Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what's handed to you
Qualifications
Proven track record of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on net-new logo acquisition and building a regional territory from scratch
A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work
Hunting mentality: demonstrated drive to self-generate pipeline, prospect into target accounts, and close new business independently

Ability to build influential relationships across matrixed organisations and turn professional networks into real partnerships
"Roll up your sleeves" attitude that pervades both sales and business development activities
Prior experience at AWS, ISVs, or in strategic partnerships is a big plus

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

job_description:
About Dwelly
Dwelly is a UK proptech company that grows by acquiring independent estate and letting agencies. Around 25 have joined so far, with more every quarter. Each acquisition brings its own IT estate, legacy suppliers and ways of working, which we bring onto a common group standard.
Our IT runs as a lean, service-integrator model. A small central team owns architecture, standards and vendor decisions; our managed service provider, the MSP, delivers hands-on engineering and support across the agencies. As the portfolio grows, we scale the MSP contract and automation rather than internal headcount.
The role
You will own every IT project with a start and an end: bringing newly acquired agencies under group control, onboarding them to our MSP, running their digital transformation, and delivering group-wide IT rollouts.
You sit on the client side. the MSP does the engineering; you make sure the right work happens, in the right order, to our standards, on time and within the agreed Statement of Work. You are the person agency directors, the MSP and the central team turn to for "where are we and what's next".
You report to the Head of IT Operations and work closely with Dwelly's Head of IT & Security, the M&A and integration team, and the MSP's delivery leads.
What you'll do
Agency takeover
• Run IT discovery at newly acquired agencies: tenants, domains and DNS, phone lines and numbers, network and hardware, SaaS accounts and who holds the keys.
• Secure group control of every admin account and credential, and get the MSP the access it needs to start work.
• Keep a single, current inventory of what we own and control at each agency.
Exit from legacy IT providers
• Manage the operational handover from each agency's outgoing IT supplier: handover requests, timelines, follow-up and proof that everything has been transferred.
• Gather the contracts, notice terms and evidence the Head of IT Operations needs when commercial terms are disputed.
Onboarding to Dwelly’s nation-wide MSP
• Plan and run each agency's onboarding from discovery to the point it is live on the standard managed service.
• Coordinate site surveys, cutover days and communication with agency staff.
Digital transformation
• Own each agency's transformation project from the client side: requirements, stakeholders, plan, risks and staff communication.
• Check the MSP scope and delivery against the agreed SoW and our Target Architecture framework; accept milestones, manage change requests and flag deviations.
Group-wide IT projects
• Deliver central rollouts across the estate, such as backup, email security baselines or print management pilots.
Playbook
• Turn takeover, supplier exit and onboarding into a repeatable playbook (checklists, templates and standard letters to outgoing suppliers), so every new agency is faster than the last.
What this role is not
• Not BAU support. Day-to-day tickets, SLAs and post-onboarding support sit with the central IT team and the MSP's service desk.
• Not hands-on engineering. You need to understand the technical work well enough to challenge it, but the MSP's engineers do it.
• Not architecture. Standards, target architecture and exceptions are owned by the Head of IT Operations; your job is to deliver against them and surface where they don't fit.
What we're looking for
Essential
• Several years as a project manager or service delivery manager at a UK managed service provider, or on the client side managing one. You know how MSPs scope, price and deliver work, and where they cut corners.
• Hands-on experience running SMB IT onboardings or migrations: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace tenant moves, network and broadband changes, telephony and number porting, device refreshes.
• Technical literacy without being an engineer: you can read a SoW, question an estimate and spot a missing step in a cutover plan.
• Comfortable working with non-technical people. Agency directors and negotiators care about their phones, email and listings working on Monday, not about the architecture behind it.
• Organised and persistent: you chase outgoing suppliers politely until the last password is handed over.
Nice to have
• Experience in a buy-and-build or M&A integration environment.
• Background in property, estate agency or another multi-site SMB sector.
• Familiarity with ITSM tools (Jira Service Management or similar) and identity basics (Entra ID, MFA, admin roles).
• PRINCE2, PMP or similar. Useful, but we value delivery track record over certificates.
How we'll measure success
• Time to integrate: days from deal close to the agency being live on group IT, trending down.
• Day-one success: agencies working normally on cutover day, without critical issues.
• Transformation delivery: projects delivered on schedule and within the agreed SoW budget.
• SoW quality: milestones accepted without rework.
• Fewer escalations: less onboarding and transformation work landing on the Head of IT Operations.
 
What is it like being a Dwell-er
Feel free to check out Dwelly Core Principles. That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.
What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for >30% of households (>5M in the UK, and >100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.
This is about disrupting the largest, most antiquated industry in the world, with one of the strongest operational and technical teams that exist in the UK and the EU. We work hard, and we shoot for extremely ambitious results. But we want people to be proud of what they’ve built and be able to look back and say one day “hell yeah, that was me that did it all”.

Are you passionate about turning complex data challenges into clear, scalable product solutions?
Do you enjoy leading through ambiguity, shaping roadmaps, and helping teams deliver high-quality outcomes in an evolving AI-enabled environment?
About our Team
DBS Product Management is a newly established team focused on products and data products. Our vision is a future where every colleague has trustworthy data they confidently use to streamline processes, drive smarter decisions and accelerate growth. We identify the products and data products that matter most to Elsevier and shape what they look like.
The Enterprise Product Hub (EPH) is central to that vision. It masters Elsevier’s saleable product data in a single governed model and publishes it to around thirty systems across the business. With books and journals established, the priority now is bringing digital products to the same standard as Elsevier transforms how it sells and invoices its products.
About the Role
The Senior Data Product Manager owns an evolving area of the EPH product estate – the attributes that enable us to sell a product, from what it’s called to how it’s identified and how it’s sold. You will report to the Head of Product Data.
This role complements the existing product management by taking responsibility for a current gap in our data estate: the ingestion and publication of digital product data. It is a greenfield build with no agreed blueprint. You will work with the business to define what digital product data should be (what it covers, who relies on it, what good looks like), then shape and deliver the digital product lifecycle solution that publishes it across A&G, Health and Corporate Markets, alongside the existing books and journals data.
This is a delivery-first role: you will work closely with EPH business and engineering colleagues and represent EPH's position in cross-team decisions, with a meaningful second strand; coaching and growing the analysts around you.
Your success will be measured by the quality of the decisions you make under ambiguity, the analysts you grow, and – above all – the extent to which the product data you own helps Elsevier go to market more effectively and makes the customer buying experience better.
Responsibilities
• Partner with commercial, finance and digital product teams to define the products and data products they need: scope, consumers, quality and success measures.
• Bring structure to unclear problems: frame the question, test assumptions with the business, make the call and record the rationale so others can follow it.
• Own your product area’s roadmap and success measures, making prioritisation and scope calls based on business value to Elsevier as a whole.
• Build strong relationships across business and engineering teams, and drive consumer adoption through governance, guidance and clear data documentation.

job_description:
Join the Molecular Networks team at EMBL-EBI and help build the next generation of biological knowledge resources used by researchers worldwide. Our team develops and operates internationally recognised data resources including IntAct and Complex Portal, which provide expertly curated information on molecular interactions and macromolecular complexes. These resources support systems biology, drug discovery, and biomedical research by making complex biological knowledge accessible through high-quality curation, modern data services, and programmatic APIs.
We are seeking a Scientific Data Curator to contribute to the curation and integration of molecular interaction and macromolecular complex data. In this role, you will work at the intersection of biocuration, bioinformatics, and emerging AI-assisted curation technologies, helping to extract and structure biological knowledge from the scientific literature and integrate it into internationally used biological databases.
Your role
This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to globally used biological knowledgebases IntAct and Complex Portal.
You will curate and integrate biological knowledge about molecular interactions and macromolecular complexes, ensuring that the data captured in these resources is accurate, consistent, and useful to the international scientific community.
Working closely with bioinformaticians, software developers, and international collaborators, you will contribute to the development of modern curation workflows that combine expert manual curation with AI-assisted literature mining and knowledge extraction tools.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Curating molecular interaction and complex information from the scientific literature and direct user data depositions
• Capturing biological knowledge using controlled vocabularies, ontologies, and community data standards
• Validating and improving data extracted through AI-assisted literature mining tools
• Collaborating with software developers to improve biocuration tools and curation pipelines
• Contributing to the development and application of community standards for molecular interaction data
• Supporting data integration with other EMBL-EBI resources and international biological databases
• Engaging with the scientific community to ensure high-quality representation of experimental data
As part of the team, you will interact with an international community of researchers, database users, and collaborators, helping ensure that the curated knowledge captured in these resources remains accurate, comprehensive, and accessible.
You have
• A PhD or MSc in molecular biology, bioinformatics, systems biology, or a related life science discipline
• Strong understanding of molecular biology, protein interactions, or cellular pathways
• Experience in analysing and interpreting scientific literature
• Familiarity with biological databases or bioinformatics resources
• Experience in data curation, knowledge representation, and biological data standards
• Strong interest in intelligent use of AI • Experience in LLM use in a biological data context
• Ability to work with structured data and attention to detail
• Strong organisational and analytical skills
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international team
• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and English language skills
You may also have
• Experience with biocuration and/or annotation of biological databases
• Experience with ontologies and controlled vocabularies (e.g. Gene Ontology or PSI-MI)
• Experience using bioinformatics tools or scripting languages (e.g. Python or R)
• Experience in text mining, natural language processing, or AI-assisted literature analysis
• Experience working with large biological datasets, and with analytical/visualisation tools such as Cytoscape
• Experience collaborating in international scientific projects or consortia
Contract length: 3 years, renewable to a maximum of 9 years. Salary: Grade 5 or 6 (depending on qualifications and experience). Monthly salary from £3,452 or £3,861 after tax, plus generous benefits and financial allowances depending on individual circumstances. Excluding 12.99% personal pension and insurance contributions.
Interviews: We plan to hold interviews via Zoom in December 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted with further details.
Why join us
Do something meaningful
At EMBL-EBI you can apply your talent and passion to accelerate science and tackle some of humankind's greatest challenges. EMBL-EBI, part of the European Molecular Biology Laboratory, is a worldwide leader in the storage, analysis and dissemination of large biological datasets. We provide the global research community with access to publicly available databases and tools which are crucial for the advancement of healthcare, food security, and biodiversity.
Join a culture of innovation
We are located on the Wellcome Genome Campus, alongside other prominent research and biotech organisations, and surrounded by beautiful Cambridgeshire countryside. This is a highly collaborative and inclusive community where our employees enjoy a relaxed atmosphere. We are committed to ensuring our employees feel valued, supported and empowered to reach their professional potential. Watch this video to see how EMBL-EBI makes an impact.

job_title: Senior Director, Product Owner - Entity Data & Knowledge Graph (London)
job_description:
Senior Director, Product Owner – Entity Data & Knowledge Graph in our London office.   
 
Fitch Solutions is a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. It informs investment strategies, strengthens risk management capabilities and helps identify strategic opportunities. Its analysts, lawyers, journalists and economists offer in-depth views on credit markets and risk, individual credits, ESG, developed and emerging markets, and industry sectors. Fitch Solutions is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Fitch Group is owned by Hearst. 
By becoming part of the Fitch Solutions team, you will join colleagues delivering critical data, insightful research and comprehensive analytics that empower clients to make informed decisions. You will work in a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged and collaboration is central to developing solutions that address the evolving needs of global markets. With a portfolio of best-in-class, award-winning brands, we offer the opportunity to advance your career while contributing to a company known for its expertise and commitment to excellence.  
 
About the Team
Platform Products is responsible for building shared capabilities that can be leveraged across the organization. We operate a product-led model focused on identifying common business needs, building reusable solutions once and enabling business units to adopt them at scale. At the heart of this is Fitch's entity and reference data foundation: the identifiers, symbology, hierarchies and relationships that connect our data across products and make it usable by clients, applications and AI.
Our mission is to accelerate innovation, improve consistency and reduce duplication by delivering platform capabilities across Fitch Solutions. While business units focus on domain expertise and commercial differentiation, Platform Products develops the foundational capabilities that support them all, including the entity services and knowledge graph that link Fitch's data together.
This is a senior individual contributor role for a hands-on product owner. You will own a portfolio of platform data products centered on entity resolution, symbology and knowledge graph capabilities, and you will work close to the detail. That means defining data models and ontologies, writing requirements, working through data quality problems, validating solutions with engineering and getting capabilities into production. You will lead through influence rather than line management. You will shape the vision and roadmap, align senior stakeholders, and steer cross-functional squads of engineers, architects and analysts to deliver scalable, reusable products that create measurable value across the business.
 
How You'll Make an Impact
Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Fitch's shared entity and reference data capabilities. This includes entity resolution, symbology and identifier mapping, corporate hierarchies and ownership, and the knowledge graph that connects them.
Get hands-on with the data. Define entity and relationship models, ontologies and metadata standards; profile and investigate data; shape matching and linkage logic; and write detailed requirements and acceptance criteria.
Build deep expertise in Fitch's data, products, underlying architecture and integration points, and use it to guide investment decisions and how the platform evolves.
Deliver entity resolution and matching services that business units and clients can use to identify, link and enrich data consistently, whether through APIs, bulk feeds or cloud data-sharing channels.
Make Fitch's data AI-ready. Expose entities and relationships to LLMs and AI agents through graph services, APIs and emerging protocols such as MCP, with the metadata and provenance that let agents discover, navigate and trust them.
Define and track data quality measures such as accuracy, coverage, fill rates and timeliness, alongside product measures such as adoption, reuse, client value and return on investment. Use them to set priorities and show impact.
Own the product backlog in Jira, balancing strategic initiatives, business demand, technical enablement, risk and scalability, and translating goals into epics, investment cases and delivery plans.
Run build-vs-buy and partner evaluations across data vendors, graph technologies and cloud platforms, and turn recommendations into delivery.
Lead entity and reference data governance, covering identifier lifecycle, data model change control, standards and stewardship across domains.
Drive adoption across business units by navigating competing priorities, resolving cross-portfolio dependencies and blockers, and escalating effectively when executive decisions are needed.
Sponsor validation, user acceptance testing and release readiness so delivered capabilities meet business, control and quality expectations.
Produce and champion clear product documentation, including data dictionaries, model specifications, process flows and release communications, to support transparency and adoption.
Represent Platform Products in senior leadership discussions, communicating strategy, progress, risks and outcomes with clarity and credibility.
Strengthen the product operating model by introducing practices that improve discovery, prioritization, delivery and measurement.
 
You May Be a Good Fit If
You have 10+ years of experience in product ownership, product management or data product roles, with a substantial focus on entity and reference data.
You have deep expertise in entity and reference data. This includes legal entity and company data, instrument reference data and symbology, global identifiers (such as LEI, PermID, FIGI, ISIN and CUSIP), and corporate hierarchies and ownership structures.
You have a proven record of building entity resolution, matching and deduplication capabilities at scale, across millions of entities and multiple sources.
You have hands-on experience with knowledge graphs or graph databases, including ontology design and relationship modelling.
You have substantial experience at a financial information provider, data and analytics firm, exchange or financial institution.
You have delivered shared data capabilities used across multiple business units or client segments.
You have led cross-functional squads through influence in a matrixed organization, and you can align executives and technical stakeholders around complex priorities and investment decisions.
You have strong knowledge of Agile and product-led delivery practices and tools such as Jira.
You use data quality metrics, client insight and business outcomes to guide prioritization and measure success.
You have exceptional written and verbal communication skills and can explain complex data concepts to technical, business and executive audiences.
You have a bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
 
What Would Make You Stand Out
You have built or run an entity graph, symbology service or master data platform at a major data provider, exchange or bank.
You have experience with industry identifier schemes and open data standards, or have managed a public-facing identifier or entity data service.
You have a background in credit, credit risk or private markets data, and understand how entity data drives credit analysis, counterparty risk and client workflows.
You combine sound commercial judgment with a customer-centric, enterprise-wide perspective.
You have knowledge of Fitch systems, products, data or client workflows.
You show initiative, intellectual curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning.
 
 Why Choose Fitch:  
Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location  
A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity 
Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals 
Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing 
Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively 
Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe 
Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community 
 
At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done. 
 
 
Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.  
Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

About you
You’re interested in pioneering technology and its potential to support a more sustainable future. You’re motivated by the opportunity to contribute to work with real-world impact and help advance battery intelligence.
